A macOS app that builds random-sample scripts for Photo Supreme (IDimager).

**Install:** open the `.dmg` attached below, drag SupremeSampler to
Applications.

**First launch:** this build is ad-hoc signed, not notarized, so macOS
quarantines it and refuses the first launch. Either right-click the app in
Applications and choose **Open**, or run:

    xattr -cr /Applications/SupremeSampler.app

`SHA256SUMS` is attached if you want to verify the download.

Requires macOS 14 or later.
